explainer_content.short_definition: Film-score and cinematic instrumental music where motif, orchestration, and atmosphere carry narrative memory.
explainer_content.history_capsule: John Williams, Hans Zimmer, Ennio Morricone, Howard Shore, Danny Elfman, Vangelis, and others show how score becomes standalone listening.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gives Atlas a path for listeners who respond to scale, tension, wonder, and story-world immersion more than songs.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The music is often built to serve image and narrative, then later becomes a personal listening object.
